plan_reference: reports/week20_project_charter.md | section 1 | W20-1 eta fairness review
purpose: Remove the two non-removable self-declared boundaries of W19-D5 (single-config single-seed frozen XGB incumbent vs three-seed Chemprop ensemble; a single 20 percent grouped hold-out with no fold-level variance) and re-ask whether the eta channel crosses its 0.15 gate out of fold.

w19_d5_self_declared_boundaries: The incumbent was a frozen single-configuration, single-seed XGBoost while the Chemprop arm was a three-seed ensemble, so part of the gap could be ensembling or re-tuning rather than representation.
The grouped protocol was a single 20 percent hold-out draw, so there was no fold-level variance; the three Chemprop seeds probed initialization variance only, not split variance.

budget_alignment.rule: The incumbent arm is granted the tuning and multi-seed budget it was denied in W19-D5, so that any surviving delta cannot be attributed to ensembling or to a frozen configuration.
budget_alignment.incumbent_arm: MorganTemperatureXGBoost: a pre-registered three-configuration grid, selected inside each training fold by an inner GroupKFold(3) by InChIKey (training rows only), then refit with a three-seed ensemble on the full training rows.
budget_alignment.chemprop_arm: Chemprop D-MPNN with the W19-D5 registered configuration, three-seed ensemble, no search (the search budget is spent on the incumbent, the arm that was denied it).
budget_alignment.asymmetry_declared: The incumbent arm receives strictly more fitting budget than the Chemprop arm (grid search plus ensemble vs ensemble only). The design is therefore conservative against the Chemprop arm: any surviving Chemprop advantage survives a more generously funded incumbent.

split_upgrade.previous_protocol: sklearn.model_selection.GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.2, random_state=42) by inchikey (the incumbent viscosity split, W19-D5).
split_upgrade.new_protocol: sklearn.model_selection.GroupKFold by inchikey, 5 folds times 5 repeats.
split_upgrade.repeat_mechanism: Repeat r draws a row permutation with numpy.random.default_rng(seed_r).permutation(n), then GroupKFold(n_splits=5).split(...) is run over the row order induced by that permutation. Different repeats therefore assign different groups to different folds while every fold remains group-disjoint and the five folds of a repeat partition the rows.
identity_assertions: no inchikey appears in both the train and the test side of any fold
the five test folds of a repeat partition the row set exactly
split_upgrade.why: Five folds give fold-level variance that a single 20 percent draw cannot give; five repeats average over split draws so a single lucky or unlucky group assignment cannot decide the verdict.

pools_unchanged.rule: The pools, the target and the units are reused verbatim; no row is added, removed or reweighted.

target_and_units_unchanged.rule: identical to the incumbent viscosity baseline and to W19-D5

incumbent_in_place_reproduction.role: prior / drift anchor, registered before the run
incumbent_in_place_reproduction.procedure: Rebuild the incumbent XGBoost on the W19-D5 GroupShuffleSplit(seed 42) split and compare with the frozen readings.
incumbent_in_place_reproduction.assertion: abs_gap == 0.0 for both pools; a non-zero gap voids the run

incumbent_aligned.features: Morgan count radius 2 fpSize 2048 + T_K + 1000/T_K (frozen viscosity_baseline.build_feature_matrix)
incumbent_aligned.selection: inner GroupKFold(3) by InChIKey on the training rows only; the configuration with the lowest mean inner-validation MAE is selected; ties break by grid order
incumbent_aligned.prediction_rule: mean of the three members of the selected configuration

chemprop_aligned.model: Chemprop D-MPNN (BondMessagePassing d_h=300 depth=3, NormAggregation, RegressionFFN hidden 300 n_layers 1)
chemprop_aligned.descriptor_scaling: StandardScaler fitted on the training rows of the fold only

criterion.delta_definition: delta = MAE_chemprop_cross_seed_mean - MAE_incumbent_cross_seed_mean, both pooled over the 5x5 grid of grouped out-of-fold test cells, in log10(cP)
criterion.gate_state_unchanged_definition: the Chemprop arm still clears 0.15 (cross-seed mean) AND the incumbent arm still fails 0.15 (cross-seed mean), exactly as in W19-D5

branches.reading: The two arms are not resolvable at the registered tolerance under the upgraded protocol.
The eta channel crosses its gate out of fold under a five-fold by five-repeat grouped protocol with a budget-aligned incumbent.
The Chemprop arm still leads, but the gate-pass pattern changed once the incumbent was budget-aligned.
The budget-aligned incumbent wins by more than the tolerance.

criterion.branch_precedence: the abs(delta) <= 0.02 branch is evaluated first; the remaining branches are mutually exclusive by construction
criterion.cross_seed_reporting: For each arm the pooled 5x5 grid MAE is computed per ensemble seed; the cross-seed mean is the primary reading and the cross-seed minimum is the reported lower bound. delta is also reported per paired seed with its own minimum and maximum.

w20_3_dependency_rule.rule: Only a verdict of eta_crosses_gate_out_of_fold authorises W20-3 to fold eta into the ranking key v1. Any other verdict means W20-3 must NOT fold eta in.
w20_3_dependency_rule.explicit: If the verdict is representation_sensitive_gate_undetermined, W20-3 must not fold eta in.

placebo.description: The Chemprop arm with the log10(cP) target permuted across rows with a registered seed, scored on the identical 5x5 grouped grid with one member (seed 42).
placebo.collapse_reference: the per-cell training-mean predictor MAE pooled over the same grid; the placebo is collapsed when its grid MAE is not better (not smaller) than that constant-predictor MAE
placebo.obligation: report the placebo behaviour as measured whether or not it collapses

amendment_rule_declared_before_run.trigger: a timing probe extrapolating the registered full run beyond the box budget
amendment_rule_declared_before_run.allowed_reduction: reduce the Chemprop epoch budget 60 -> 30 (declared below); the split (5 folds x 5 repeats), the pools and the arms are NOT reduced
amendment_rule_declared_before_run.applied: epochs 60 -> 30, declared in the summary and the report
amendment_rule_declared_before_run.infeasible_path: if the run is not feasible at all the verdict is not_obtained_feasibility with measured timing evidence, and infeasibility is not dressed up as a scientific conclusion

red_lines.frozen_comparison_protocol_untouched: 457 rows / 97 compounds / 276 (compound,T) pairs / 2029 epsilon full-table training rows
red_lines.writes_no_shared_files: does not write reports/decisions_log.md, README.md, paper/ or any frozen data/ artifact
